card.name: Subject word before an organization's action verb
card.fires_on: Words that start a clause and name an agency, group or site as the doer, such as 'providers', 'We', 'the' or 'governmental'. They often come just before a verb like endorse, discover or hope.

modes.label: Disclaimer subjects
modes.description: Group or site subject in a website disclaimer, just before a verb about endorsing or hoping.
modes.example: in no way implies that these content<< providers>> endorse the products and services advertised.

modes.label: Authority modifiers
modes.description: Adjective or pronoun naming a ruling body or agency, before policy or agency nouns.
modes.example: approved by the appropriate<< governmental>> agency authorized to license the use of radi

modes.label: Other clause subjects
modes.description: Pronoun or article starting a clause whose subject is a person, group or search engines.
modes.example: once<< the>> search engines discover what they are doing.
